title.narrative: Transforming futures: Enhancing capacities for ESD for 2030

description.narrative: In building on the outcomes of the recently finalized “Activating ESD for 2030” (516GLO1002) and ongoing “Putting into practice ESD for 2030” (533GLO1001) projects funded by the Government of Japan, the proposed new project aims to strengthen the function of the ESD-Net 2030 as a laboratory of innovation for ESD in order to effectively support the capacity of education sectors and stakeholders to implement ESD. More specifically, the project will support the development of new knowledge and ideas through ‘global action research’ on some of the key factors of transformation needing more understanding and action, the capacity building and learning activities of the ESD-NET 2030 at the regional level, the documentation and exchange on the trends and emerging issues of ESD in the era of digital and green transformations, as well as the monitoring of the implementation of the ESD for 2030 Roadmap and Framework. These activities will greatly contribute to supporting and strengthening countries efforts to implement the ESD for 2030 country initiatives, and pave the ground for discussing “post-2030” ESD.
